text:
morgan: heads-up — brought v2p1-quant4 into a tiny canary and seeing a weird long-doc quality shift. want to agree gate thresholds and auto-fallback behavior before we move to 5%
liam: what are the numbers so far?
tara: +1 — also we should surface slice-level concordance, not just aggregate mrr
liam: quick summary from the first 12k requests (1% traffic): baseline vs v2p1-quant4 -> long_doc_mrr: 0.421 -> 0.416 (-1.2%), hallucination_rate: 0.020 -> 0.023 (+15%), latency_p95: 110ms -> 135ms (+22%)
jen: ran the eval harness earlier, here's the run snippet:
```
# eval-bot run
./eval_runner --baseline=rlf-v2 --candidate=v2p1-quant4 --slices=long_doc,code,faq --samples=12000
```
results attached in the report (summary above).
jen: notable: the regression is concentrated in the long_doc slice; faq and short replies stable
mohit: that aligns with quantization edge-case hypothesis — kv-cache & long-seq attention sensitivity
sarah: sample size ok for early signal? 12k per arm seems decent but long-doc variance can be noisy
liam: bootstrap CI on long_doc_mrr delta: -0.012 ± 0.006 (95% CI) — borderline but persistent over PRs
tara: propose canary gating rules:
- start: 0.5–1% (smoke) with 30m observation window
- expand to 5% if: aggregate mrr delta >= -0.5% OR long_doc slice delta >= -0.75% with concordance >= 0.85
- abort/rollback if any of: long_doc_mrr delta <= -1.0% OR hallucination_rate increase >= 0.5% absolute OR latency_p95 increase >= 1.5x
- auto-fallback: immediate route fallback to baseline for 5 minutes on rolling 5-min breach, plus a canary hold for manual review
morgan: sounds reasonable. for concordance what threshold do we want? tara suggested 0.85
mohit: concordance is tricky — for long docs set 0.80 min and require delta_mrr < -0.75% to trigger fail. otherwise allow slow expand with extra sampling
jen: eval-bot output shows concordance(long_doc)=0.83 for this run
liam: ops question — can we make fallback instantaneous in routing layer (no human in loop) but also send a high-priority alert?
canary-deployer: yes — routing supports policy: "instant-fallback-on-breach" + alert webhook. we can wire to #incidents and pager duty.
sarah: curious about noisy spikes — request we use a smoothed metric (exponential moving avg over 3 windows) to avoid oscillation
tara: +1 on smoothing. also require 2 consecutive windows breaching to auto-rollback unless the breach magnitude is large (e.g., mrr delta <= -1.5%)
liam: here's suggested rule encoding for rollout config (high-level):
```
canary: {
  phases: [ {traffic:1,window_min:30}, {traffic:5,window_min:60}, {traffic:20,window_min:60} ],
  expand_if: {
    aggregate_mrr_delta_gt: -0.005,
    slice_rules: [ {slice:long_doc, mrr_delta_gt: -0.0075, concordance_gt:0.80} ]
  },
  hard_fails: [ {slice:long_doc, mrr_delta_le: -0.01}, {metric:hallucination_rate, abs_increase_ge:0.005}, {metric:latency_p95, ratio_ge:1.5} ],
  auto_fallback_policy: {type:"instant", window_min:5, require_consecutive:2, notify:["#incidents","pagerduty"]}
}
```
jen: putting that into canary config now, will run a dry deploy in staging first
mohit: also recommend adding a small shadow compare run for long_doc variants at 20% to capture tail behaviors before full promote
morgan: agree. action items: jen push config to staging + run 3 sequential smoke windows; if staging matches, ops flip canary to 1% in prod with instant-fallback policy; raj on-call will get pager if breach
sarah: who will own the manual review if we hold after an auto-fallback?
tara: ML eng oncall + product lead (we'll ping product) — add runbook link in the alert payload
liam: quick check: are we seeing any user-facing error spikes? logs show minor increase in truncated responses for long docs but not errors
jen: attaching the short report link: https://internal/reports/eval/1739990001 (private)
morgan: ok rolling with the gating rules above. if anything looks worse during the 1% we flip to baseline immediately. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
canary-deployer: canary started at 1739990005 with traffic=1% (policy: instant-fallback enabled)
eval-bot: completed monitoring pass 1739990018 — no auto-fallback triggered yet; concordance long_doc=0.82, long_doc_mrr_delta=-1.1% (rolling), hallucination_abs_increase=0.003
morgan: keep this thread updated every 15m during the first two hours
liam: noted — posting next check in 15m
jen: will post staging dry-run logs when ready
mohit: tagging infra to watch kv-cache eviction logs for long sequences
